mod = 998244353

def prod(A, B, k, l, m):
    C = [[0] * m for _ in range(k)]
    for i in range(k):
        for j in range(m):
            ANS = 0
            for pl in range(l):
                ANS = (ANS + A[i][pl] * B[pl][j]) % mod
            C[i][j] = ANS
    return C

def compute_permutation_sum(P, N, M):
    if N == 2:
        return 1

    ALL = N * (N - 1) // 2

    A = [[ALL - (N - 2) * 2, (N - 2) * 2, 0],
         [1, ALL - 1 - (N - 3), N - 3],
         [0, 4, ALL - 4]]

    POWA = [A]

    for _ in range(60):
        POWA.append(prod(POWA[-1], POWA[-1], 3, 3, 3))

    X = [[1, 0, 0]]

    n = M
    while n:
        X = prod(X, POWA[n.bit_length() - 1], 1, 3, 3)
        n -= 1 << (n.bit_length() - 1)

    AS = 0
    for i in range(N):
        AS = AS + i * (i + 1) // 2

    PX = [0]
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        plus = (N - i) * (N - i + 1) // 2
        minus = (i - 1) * (i - 1 + 1) // 2
        PX.append(plus + minus)

    ANS = 0
    for i in range(N - 1):
        a, b = P[i], P[i + 1]
        ANS += abs(b - a) * X[0][0]

        k = PX[a] - abs(b - a) + PX[b] - abs(b - a)
        ANS += k * X[0][1] * pow((N - 2) * 2, mod - 2, mod) % mod

        ANS += (AS - abs(b - a) - k) * X[0][2] * pow(ALL - 1 - (N - 2) * 2, mod - 2, mod) % mod

        ANS %= mod

    return ANS % mod
